Attached: 1 image

Made Wisp, a GNOME extension that puts snapper snapshots in the top bar.

See every snapshot, take one, delete the junk. Open one to see what changed, restore single files or roll the whole system back.

Anything that needs root goes through a small polkit helper, packaged for Fedora and openSUSE. GNOME 46 to 51.

https://extensions.gnome.org/extension/10755/wisp/
https://github.com/epogonii/wisp
https://thelinuxnotes.com/wisp-snapper-snapshots-gnome-shell-extension/
